verdicts.reason: A keeps the phone and its circle together and follows a sensible top-to-bottom order, but the brand is centred while the headline is left-aligned, which is inconsistent. There are large dead gaps above and below the phone, the tagline is tiny, and the badges have moved below the CTA as separate pills, which weakens the hierarchy. B separates the green circle from the phone, so it now sits behind the SOLSTICE wordmark and the headline as an accidental overlap. The phone is jammed against the top edge and off-axis, and the badges and CTA have different widths, so the stack looks ragged.
